Sections.Name: General
Sections.Description: Core Player voice behavior and conversation presentation.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Master switch for Player speech.

Keys.Name: AutomaticBarks
Keys.Description: Allow automatic contextual barks.

Keys.Name: VoiceDialogueChoices
Keys.Description: Voice supported player dialogue choices and normal Talk-window questions.

Keys.Name: EnhancedNpcvoConversationUI
Keys.Description: When the NPC module is present, share player identity for enhanced quest presentation and the non-destructive normal Ask UI portrait/bio augmentation.

Keys.Name: PlayerPortraitStyle
Keys.Description: Player portrait presentation used by the NPC module.

Sections.Name: Voice
Sections.Description: Choose the player voice. An exact Voice Override takes precedence over the customization controls. Voice selection, depth, speed, and audio style are remembered per character.

Keys.Name: VoiceOverride
Keys.Description: Optional exact packaged Kokoro voice ID. Leave blank to use the accent/gender/delivery selectors. Character Creation can browse the voices physically bundled with Daggerfall Voice Engine.

Keys.Name: Accent
Keys.Description: Player voice accent family.

Keys.Name: Gender
Keys.Description: Player voice gender.

Keys.Name: Delivery
Keys.Description: General voice character. This selects a suitable packaged Kokoro voice.

Keys.Name: Depth
Keys.Description: Voice depth. 50 is neutral; higher is deeper, lower is lighter.

Keys.Name: Speed
Keys.Description: Speech speed percentage.

Keys.Name: Volume
Keys.Description: Player voice volume percentage.

Keys.Name: UseGameSoundVolume
Keys.Description: Scale with Daggerfall Unity's normal sound volume.

Keys.Name: AudioStyle
Keys.Description: Kokoro post-processing style.

Keys.Name: CharacterCreationVoice
Keys.Description: Show the packaged-voice browser and live Preview button during character creation. The chosen voice, depth, speed, and quality are saved for that character.

Sections.Name: Personality
Sections.Description: Birthsign-inspired roleplay archetype for authored barks. Voice settings are completely separate.

Keys.Name: Birthsign
Keys.Description: Determines worldview, backstory flavor, and bark tone without changing stats or the game's actual birthsign. The Apprentice is the Agent: new to the land, quiet, mission-focused, and sparing with words.

Keys.Name: RaceFlavor
Keys.Description: Allow cultural/racial perspective to flavor personality-authored reactions when a specific combined line exists.

Keys.Name: CharacterCreationIntegration
Keys.Description: During character creation, use the completed biography Q&A to suggest a birthsign archetype, then show a manual picker before play. This never changes stats or the game's actual birthsign.

Options: Hybrid - tap bark / hold to type
Keys.Name: BarkKeyMode
Keys.Description: What the Bark key does.

Keys.Name: BarkKey
Keys.Description: Keyboard key used for manual bark / speech input.

Keys.Name: HoldToTypeMilliseconds
Keys.Description: Hybrid mode hold duration before opening keyboard speech.

Keys.Name: Frequency
Keys.Description: Automatic bark frequency.

Keys.Name: AutomaticCooldownSeconds
Keys.Description: Minimum global delay between automatic barks.

Keys.Name: ManualCooldownSeconds
Keys.Description: Anti-spam delay between manual barks.

Keys.Name: ActionMovieMode
Keys.Description: Context-aware movie-reference one-liners, adapted to Tamriel when appropriate.

Keys.Name: SubtitleMode
Keys.Description: Optional subtitles for automatic/manual barks and typed player speech. The speaker label is visual only and is never sent to Kokoro.

Keys.Name: AutoStartVoiceEngine
Keys.Description: Automatically launch the bundled Daggerfall Voice Engine when it is not already running.

Keys.Name: HealthAndVitals
Keys.Description: React to health, fatigue, magicka, breath, encumbrance, and related player-state changes.

Keys.Name: ClimatesCalories
Keys.Description: Use Climates & Calories hunger/thirst/temperature context when available.

Keys.Name: QuestAwareBarks
Keys.Description: Use quest start/resolution and supported structured quest context.

Keys.Name: NPCVO
Keys.Description: Integrate with the Daggerfall Narrator - NPC module when installed.

Keys.Name: AutoManageCache
Keys.Description: Automatically trim generated Player WAVs.

Keys.Name: MaxCacheSize
Keys.Description: Maximum generated Player speech cache size.
